title: HomePlugin
description: A lightweight home management system for Paper servers featuring a clean GUI and multi-home support.
body:
## 🏠 HomePlugin

A lightweight and intuitive home management system for Paper servers.  
This plugin allows players to save locations and return to them instantly, featuring a clean GUI for a modern user experience.

---

## ✨ Features
- 📍 **Multi-Home System** — Set, delete, and manage multiple home locations with ease.
- 🖥️ **Interactive GUI** — Access and manage your homes through a visual menu.
- ⚡ **Safe Teleportation** — Managed teleportation system to ensure players arrive safely.
- 🛡️ **Admin Tools** — Dedicated commands for staff to oversee and manage player homes.
- ⚙️ **Fully Configurable** — Customize settings and messages via `config.yml`.

---

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/sethome ` | Save your current location as a home. |
| `/home [name]` | Teleport to a saved home or open the GUI. |
| `/delhome ` | Delete an existing home location. |
| `/homesadmin` | Administrative tools for managing homes. |
| `/homereload` | Reload the plugin configuration. |

---

## ⚙ Config
- Customize all **plugin messages**.
- Manage **home data** and internal settings via `config.yml`.

---

## 📌 Setup
- **Software**: Paper 1.21 - 1.21.11
- **Java**: Version 21+
